LanguageData.ButcherSpot.label: butcher spot
LanguageData.ButcherSpot.description: A place for butchering animals. Due to the lack of equipment, butchering here yields only 50% of the meat and leather of each creature.
LanguageData.CraftingSpot.label: crafting spot
LanguageData.CraftingSpot.description: A place for crafting simple items like knives or bows. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.
LanguageData.ResearchingSpot.label: researching spot
LanguageData.ResearchingSpot.description: A place to do simple research.
LanguageData.StoneChippingSpot.label: stone chipping spot
LanguageData.StoneChippingSpot.description: A place to chip stones into useable blocks
